Name: The Return Of More Backpack Upgrades
Author: platinummyr
Description:
Uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21588]The Return of Custom Backpack Framework[/url] and Content Patcher to add additional backpack upgrades ﻿for a maximum of 72 inventory slots. The upgrades are now:

[list]
[*]Large Backpack - 24 slots, 2,000g
[*]Deluxe Backpack - 36 slots, 10,000g
[*]Super Backpack - 48 slots, 50,000g
[*]Superduper Backpack - 60 slots, 250,000g
[*]Supercalifragalistic Backpack - 72 slots, 1,000,000g
[/list]
You can edit the content.json to change the number of upgrades, cost, etc.

This mod was originally created by Aedenthorn and was available as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13827]More Backpack Upgrades[/url] This version is updated to support Stardew Valley 1.6, targeting the updated Custom Backpack Framework.

Source for this mod is available at [url=https://github.com/jacob-keller/CPMoreBackpackUpgrades]https://github.com/jacob-keller/CPMoreBackpackUpgrades[/url]
